package fixture

// Data for TestPurityStateSelfTest (rule P5, package-level state). A line that must
// be flagged ends with the marker "want": a declaration that is not one of the five
// allowed forms, or a use of an allowed variable that is not read-only.

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"time"

	"github.com/rbenzing/minutiae/internal/recordtypes/common"
)

// (a) interface assertions, (b) error sentinels, (c) regexps, (d) read-only tables, (e) a schema
var _ iface = (*impl)(nil)
var _ iface = impl{}
var _ = impl(nil)
var ErrBad = errors.New("bad")
var errWrapped = fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", ErrBad)
var nameRE = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z]+$`)
var table = [...]int{1, 2, 3}
var lookup = map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}
var names = []string{"a", "b", "c"}
var limits = [2]time.Duration{time.Second, 2 * time.Minute}
var rows = []struct {
	name string
	size int
}{{"x", 1}, {"y", 2}}
var grid = [2][2]int{{1, 2}, {3, 4}}
var schema = common.Schema{Name: "x"}

func reads(i int) (string, int) {
	_ = table[1]
	_ = len(names) + cap(names) + len(lookup)
	for i := range table {
		_ = i
	}
	for _, n := range names {
		_ = n
	}
	for k, v := range lookup {
		_, _ = k, v
	}
	if names == nil {
		return "", 0
	}
	x := lookup["a"]
	y := rows[0].name
	z := grid[1][0] + int(limits[0])
	_ = nameRE.MatchString("x")
	_ = errors.Is(errWrapped, ErrBad)
	_ = schema.Validate(nil)
	var shadowed = []int{1}
	shadowed[0] = 2
	names := []string{"local"} // a new variable that only shares the name
	names[0] = "other"
	return y, x + z + len(names)
}

// violating declarations
var Exported = map[string]int{"a": 1}           // want
var ExportedTable = []int{1, 2}                 // want
var cache = &impl{}                             // want
var counter int                                 // want
var hook = func() {}                            // want
var ExportedRE = regexp.MustCompile("x")        // want
var plain = impl{}                              // want
var _ = sideEffect()                            // want
var fromCall = compute()                        // want
var pairA, pairB = pair()                       // want
var dynamic = []string{compute()}               // want
var nestedSlice = [][]int{{1}}                  // want
var nestedMap = map[string][]string{"a": {"b"}} // want
var pointers = []*impl{nil}                     // want
var addresses = []*int{&counter}                // want
var ExportedSchema = common.Schema{}            // want
var emptyCache = map[string]int{}               // a literal of no constants: the writes below are what is flagged
var errSwapped = errors.New("x")
var reRebound = regexp.MustCompile("y")

// violating uses of allowed variables
var written = []string{"a"}
var sorted = []string{"b", "a"}
var passed = []int{1}
var leaked = []int{1}
var aliased = []int{1}
var counted = [2]int{1, 2}
var addressed = [2]int{1, 2}
var deleted = map[string]int{"a": 1}
var copied = []int{1}
var cleared = []int{1}
var appended = []int{1}
var methodCalled = []time.Duration{1}
var sliced = [3]int{1, 2, 3}
var rangeAssigned = []int{1}
var viaStruct = []int{1}
var summed = [2]int{1, 2}
var schemaAlias = common.Schema{}
var schemaWritten = common.Schema{}

func writes() []int {
	written[0] = "x"                 // want
	sort.Strings(sorted)             // want
	use(passed)                      // want
	counted[0]++                     // want
	p := &addressed                  // want
	delete(deleted, "a")             // want
	copy(copied, []int{2})           // want
	clear(cleared)                   // want
	appended = append(appended, 2)   // want
	_ = methodCalled[0].String()     // want
	t := sliced[:]                   // want
	for rangeAssigned[0] = range t { // want
	}
	z := aliased                  // want
	h := holder{items: viaStruct} // want
	_ = summed + summed           // want
	emptyCache["k"] = 1           // want
	errSwapped = nil              // want
	reRebound = nil               // want
	s2 := schemaAlias             // want
	schemaWritten.Name = "y"      // want
	_, _, _, _ = p, z, h, s2
	return leaked // want
}
